_about: Stores the local catalog index reads (catalog_match/sitemaps.py, scripts/build_catalog_index.py).
product_path: a regular expression the PATH of a product page matches (English UAE pages only: the other
countries and the Arabic pages repeat the same products). The patterns match the product pages of the live runs
(exports of 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-05) and of the stores' own sitemaps (checked 2026-10-06).
sitemaps: where a harvest starts (else the Sitemap: lines of robots.txt). sitemap_include: the child sitemaps
of an index that are read (the others are skipped). 'python scripts/build_catalog_index.py --discover --stores <key>'
prints both, ready to paste, from what the store publishes.
A store is disabled when it publishes no product sitemap, when robots.txt forbids it, or when its page slugs
often leave out the brand (noon, Union Coop): the index finds rows by the brand's words. Its note says why.
sitemap_hosts (optional): other hosts that serve the store's sitemaps (a CDN its robots.txt points to);
their files are read, but product pages still have to be on 'hosts'.

stores.name: Lulu Hypermarket UAE
stores.note: e.g. /en-ae/al-alali-fancy-meat-tuna-in-water-170-g/p/14751. robots.txt (2026-10-06): '*' may read the sitemaps, Crawl-delay 1, one sitemap per country and language (only en-ae is read). Slugs lead with the brand (64 of the 65 product pages the live runs kept). From the build machine the en-ae sitemap answered 403 (Cloudflare) to the index's User-Agent, so its size and children are not known yet: where that happens the refresh records the store BLOCKED and asks again after 7 days, nothing is worked around. Run '--discover --stores lulu' on the server and paste the sitemap_include it prints.

stores.name: Carrefour UAE
stores.note: e.g. /mafuae/en/beef-luncheon/zwan-beef-luncheon-meat-850gr/p/10937 (English pages only). Disabled until its sitemaps are known: from the build machine (2026-10-06) robots.txt came back as an empty HTML page (Akamai), so where its sitemaps are is not known. On the server run 'python scripts/build_catalog_index.py --discover --stores carrefour_uae', paste the three lines it prints (sitemaps, sitemap_include, enabled) here, and check that its product page samples match product_path.

stores.name: Spinneys UAE
stores.note: e.g. /en-ae/catalogue/mccain-golden-long-french-fries-750g_22359/. robots.txt (2026-10-06): sitemaps allowed, no Crawl-delay (1 s kept). One urlset of 7.4 MB: 54,619 URLs, 51,214 product pages (the rest are recipes, lifestyle and news); a full harvest takes about 30 s. Slugs lead with the brand (91 of 100 sampled; most of the others are loose produce).

stores.name: talabat mart UAE
stores.note: e.g. /uae/talabat-mart/product/ashoka-plain-paratha-400-g/s/905099 (UAE only, not /bahrain/). Disabled: talabat publishes no sitemap of its mart's product pages. robots.txt (2026-10-06) lists /sitemap/sitemap.xml.gz and /_sitemap/sitemap.xml.gz (which redirects to it): restaurants, cuisines, areas, cities, grocery / pharmacy / flower areas and static pages of every country, no /talabat-mart/product/ page; /sitemap.xml is 404. Reading it would cost about 125 files for no product.

stores.name: Sharjah Co-op
stores.note: e.g. /en/dahabi-slicesd-bread-brown-700g/p/9501100306746 (English pages only: the Product-ar sitemaps repeat the same products; loose items have ids like D000000000002, a vendor's items like V00236_6291104180277NLR).robots.txt asks for a 10 second Crawl-delay (kept: about 16 requests, 3 minutes) and Visit-time 0400-0845 UTC (kept: outside that window the store is skipped for the refresh, asked again at the next one)
